note: Declares which agents currently hold a lease on which path scopes in the shared checkout. Checked by scripts/harness/check-workspace-lease.cjs (advisory by default; TNF_WORKSPACE_LEASE_ENFORCE=1 makes Turn Zero fail loud on overlap). A lease is active until acquiredAt + ttlMinutes. Claim a lease by adding a row here and committing it — the commit IS the broadcast (R3: chat acknowledgement is not memory). Keep scopes as narrow as the work actually requires.
